behavior.surface: Three separate component sets, same geometry. light=Container + item light; blue=DB10 + item dark; background=Background + item light.
behavior.columnCollapse: state=collapsed. Width 56. Hide logo. Brand shows centered icf_Arrow_expand. Items use collapsed 40×40.
behavior.active: Branch is expanded or this row is an ancestor of the current page. Bold + arrow up. No selected fill.
behavior.hover: Not in the Figma item set. Code: keep the default look and add Background/Hover. Same for light and dark.
behavior.disabled: Not in the Figma item set. Code: opacity 50%.
behavior.branchExpand: Visible samples 4156:958 (light) and 4769:3370 (blue). Rail is 1px. Light surfaces use Background/MK_10; blue uses Background/BT_DB20. Second expand shows third list indented 12. Accordion at first level. Hide subtree when the column is collapsed.
behavior.itemCollapse: Only first-level rows have collapse=true. Hide label and arrow.
behavior.firstIcon: Lead icon follows the label. Light default / collapsed = Text/Primary. Light Active/Selected = Text/blue. Dark = Text/reversal. MK_20 is the light default arrow only.

constraints: Three menu sets share one structure. Do not fork layout per color.
Column width is 200 expanded / 56 collapsed on this board. Do not treat item master 176 as column width.
Inside the column, items fill the padded menu (200 − 16 = 184). 176 is the item master default.
Collapsed visual width of the component masters is 56. Annotation table 64/80 is discarded (SNB-007).
Blue container uses item dark. Light and background use item light.
Expanded first+second samples are instances 4156:958 (light) and 4769:3370 (blue). Default variant hides the same subtree; do not treat the hidden layer as missing.
Subtree rail does not share one color: light/background = Background/MK_10; blue = Background/BT_DB20. Do not reuse Border/default on dark.
Hover and Disabled are code rules, not Figma item variants: Hover = Background/Hover on the default look; Disabled = 50% opacity. Light and dark use the same tokens.
First-level lead icon follows the label color (Text/Primary, Text/blue, Text/reversal). Background/MK_20 is the light default arrow only, not the home icon.
Fold icon is icf_Arrow_fold (expanded) / icf_Arrow_expand (collapsed), about 24px.
Page inventory is 4 sets / 26 variants / 0 standalone. Showcase frame, annotation frame, and instance 4769:3370 are not sets.
Component column geometry is always 200 expanded / 56 collapsed from the three menu masters. Do not apply layout.sider 208/240/288 or collapsed 64/80 from node 3987:994.
